title: MEASURING AND REDUCING LLM HALLUCINATION WITHOUT GOLD-STANDARD ANSWERS
benchmark_measurement: The paper's proposed metric (FEWL) and the benchmarks used for its evaluation (Truthful-QA, CHALE, HaluEval) measure general factual correctness and hallucination. There was no specific measurement related to faith or religion.
findings: No findings related to religion as it was not a focus of this study.
